verdict.rationale: Working Copy keeps your data as standard Git repositories, an open format. The app itself exposes them for export through the Files app and a built-in WebDAV server, and it can push them to any Git remote over standard protocols. However, nothing documents a complete 'export everything' path covering identities, keys, or settings, and no one reports actually leaving the app. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all app data including identities/keys/configuration, explicit portability or exit documentation, independent corroboration of migrating away.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: All repositories in Working Copy can be accessed in the Files app and 3rd party applications using the document picker or file browser components.
a good way to get files into and out of Working Copy is the built-in WebDAV server.
Working Copy supports https, ssh, git, and http protocols.
